metadata.name: authorization
metadata.purpose: Request metadata carrying the credential token by default; the bearer scheme is stripped when present and the token is stamped as a LatticeCredential.

metadata.name: lattice-active-tenant
metadata.purpose: Request metadata carrying the asserted active tenant by default; the assertion is re-validated downstream and grants no access by itself.

auth.decision: RequireAuthorization defaults to true; GetAuthScheme is exempt and unknown operations deny by default.
